comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body: Landed 2026-10-16 (e122d553): muster window shows a queued compaction or follow-up on the agent's row with what it waits for, --json has compaction, and pane compact says it when the agent is not at its prompt. Whether a compaction or ring should wait on Claude Code's 'Waiting for N background agents' screen is unsettled until that screen is recorded: a_2j2ta8aPN.

creator: Alexander Terp
description: From tooling feedback, 2026-10-14, 0.16.0, a council on the devenv. A director queued `muster pane compact --pane p2bjgft5mc <focus>` for a Claude Code builder at 76% context. The compaction had not run 20 minutes later, and `muster window` showed the builder `working`, with no sign a compaction was queued or what held it. `muster pane read` showed why: the builder had ended its turn and sat at an empty prompt over "Waiting for 1 background agent to finish", from a sub-agent 22 minutes in. The `background_agents_working` rule reads that screen as working (a_2b8SLuYO4). Posts in the meantime answered "woke: builder (working, already woken)" and started no turn. The person noticed before the director did. Two changes would have saved the 20 minutes: show a queued compaction and what it waits on in `muster window` (e.g. `compact queued: waiting for 1 background agent`), and have `pane compact` say up front when the agent has background agents running. Whether a compaction or a ring should wait on background agents at all is worth settling at the same time.
title: A queued compaction waits unseen while Claude Code waits on background agents
